name: Miura
description: The Miura fold: a tessellation of parallelograms that opens and closes in one pull.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(18% 0, 101% 0, 83% 101%, 0 101%); clip-path: polygon(18% 0, 101% 0, 83% 101%, 0 101%); @match(@y % 2 == 1) { -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 83% 0, 101% 101%, 18% 101%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 83% 0, 101% 101%, 18% 101%); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
